     事會成員多元化政策（「政策」）並於二零二                        23rd August, 2013 and updated the Policy on 26 December, 2022. A
     二年十二月二十六日進行了更新修訂。此                          summary of this Policy, together with the measurable objectives set for

     計量目標及達標進度於下文披露。                             those objectives are disclosed as below.


     政策概要                                        Summary of the Policy

     本公司視董事會層面的多元化為維持競爭                          The Company sees diversity at Board level as an essential element in
     優勢的重要元素。一個真正多元化的董事                          maintaining a competitive advantage. A truly diverse Board will include
     會將包括具備不同技能、地區及行業經                           and make good use of differences in the skills, regional and industry
     驗、背景、性別及其他特質的董事會成                           experience, background, gender and other qualities of the members
     員，並可加以利用。該等差異將於釐定董                          of the Board. These differences will be considered in determining
     事會的最適合組成時予以考慮，並於可能                          the optimum composition of the Board and when possible should be
     情況下保持適當平衡。董事會所有委任均                          balanced appropriately. All Board appointments are made on merit, in
     按董事會整體有效運作所需要的技能及經                          the content of the skills and experience the Board as a whole requires
     驗水平作出。                                      to be effective.

提名政策                       Nomination Policy

提名政策旨在確保董事會在技能、經驗、         Nomination policy aims to ensure that the Board has a balance
知識及多元化觀點方面取得平衡，切合本         of skills, experience, knowledge and diversity of perspectives
公司的業務要求。                   appropriate to the requirements of the Company’s business.

      齡、文化背景及教育背景、專業經            cultural and educational background, professional experience,
      驗、技能、知識及服務年期；              skills, knowledge and length of service;


(b)   就可用時間及有關利益而言，對於董     (b)   Commitment for responsibilities of the Board in respect of
      事會的職責的承擔；                  available time and relevant interest;


(c)   於本公司業務所涉及的行業之成就及     (c)   Accomplishment and experience in the relevant industries in
      經驗以及其他專業資格；                which the Company’s business is involved and other professional
                                 qualifications;


(d)   誠信方面的聲譽；             (d)   Reputation for integrity;

      貢獻；                        Board;

      或多項計劃。

     長期獎勵計劃                                     LONG TERM AWARD SCHEME
     於二零零八年十二月一日，本公司採納一項                        On 1st December, 2008, the Company adopted a share repurchased
     股份購回現金獎勵計劃（「獎勵計劃」），據                       cash award scheme (the “Incentive Award Scheme”), pursuant to
     此，本集團或投資公司的經甄選僱員皆有權                        which selected employees of the Group or investee companies (being
     根據計劃規則參加獎勵計劃。投資公司乃指                        any company in which the Company directly or indirectly owns 5%
     任何一家由本公司直接或間接擁有5%或以                        or more attributable equity interests (the “Investee Company”), and
     上歸屬權益的公司（「投資公司」），就計算                       in calculating the percentage interest so attributed, the percentage
     歸屬權益百分比而言，在投資公司所持有權                        interest held in the Investee Company shall be multiplied by the
     益的百分比須乘以本集團透過其他公司持有                        percentage interest in each level of entity through which such interest
     該權益的該等中間公司的百分比。                            is held by the Group), are entitled to participate in the Incentive Award
                                                Scheme pursuant to the scheme rules.


     獎勵計劃旨在嘉許若干僱員的貢獻及鼓勵彼                        The purpose of the Incentive Award Scheme is to recognise and
     等作出貢獻，並提供獎勵及協助本集團及投                        motivate the contribution of certain employees and to provide
     資公司挽留其現有僱員及延聘更多僱員，並                        incentives and to enable the Group and the Investee Company in
     就達到本公司的長期商業目標向彼等提供直                        retaining their existing employees and recruiting additional employees
     接經濟利益。除非被董事會提前終止，獎勵                        and to provide them with a direct economic interest in attaining
     計劃自採納日期起十年內有效。根據獎勵計                        the long-term business objectives of the Company. Unless early
     劃授出獎勵股份及於其整個有效期內授予經                        termination by the Board, the Incentive Award Scheme shall be valid
     甄選僱員獎勵股份的總數上限分別以本公司                        and effective for a term of 10 years commencing on the adoption
     不時已發行股本的5%及0.5%為限。                         date. The maximum aggregate numbers of award shares which can
                                                be awarded under the Incentive Award Scheme and to a selected
                                                employee throughout its duration are limited to 5% and 0.5% of the
                                                issued share capital of the Company from time to time respectively.

  合併基準                      Basis of consolidation

  綜合財務報表包括本公司及其所控制          The consolidated financial statements incorporate the financial
  實體及其附屬公司的財務報表。倘本          statements of the Company and entities controlled by the
  公司符合以下條件時，即取得控制           Company and its subsidiaries. Control is achieved where the
  權：                        Company:


  •    可對投資對象行使權力；          •    has power over the investee;


  •    因參與投資對象業務而承受浮動       •    is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its
       回報的風險或享有權利；及              involvement with the investee; and


  •    有能力動用其權力影響其回報。       •    has the ability to use its power to affect its returns.


  倘有事實及情況顯示上述三項控制因          The Group reassesses whether or not it controls an investee if
  素之一項或多項出現變化，本集團將          facts and circumstances indicate that there are changes to one
  重新評估其是否控制投資對象。            or more of the three elements of control listed above.

 租賃 － 估計增量借貸利率                       Leases – Estimating the incremental borrowing rate

 本集團無法輕易釐定租賃內所隱含的                    The Group cannot readily determine the interest rate implicit
 利率，因此，使用增量借貸利率（「增                   in a lease, and therefore, it uses an incremental borrowing
 量借貸利率」）計量租賃負債。增量借                   rate (“IBR”) to measure lease liabilities. The IBR is the rate of
 貸利率為本集團於類似經濟環境中為                    interest that the Group would have to pay to borrow over a
 取得與使用權資產價值相近之資產，                    similar term, and with a similar security, the funds necessary to
 而以類似抵押品於類似期間借入所需                    obtain an asset of a similar value to the right-of-use asset in a
 資金應支付之利率。因此，增量借貸                    similar economic environment. The IBR therefore reflects what
 利率反映了本集團「應支付」的利率，                   the Group “would have to pay”, which requires estimation when
 當無可觀察的利率時（如就並無訂立                    no observable rates are available (such as for subsidiaries
 融資交易之附屬公司而言）或當須對                    that do not enter into financing transactions) or when it needs
 利率進行調整以反映租賃之條款及條                    to be adjusted to reflect the terms and conditions of the lease
 件時（如當租賃並非以附屬公司之功                    (for example, when leases are not in the subsidiary’s functional
 能貨幣訂立時），則須作出利率估計。                   currency). The Group estimates the IBR using observable inputs
 當可觀察輸入數據可用時，本集團使                    (such as market interest rates) when available and is required to
 用 可 觀 察 輸 入 數 據（ 如 市 場 利 率 ）估       make certain entity-specific estimates (such as the subsidiary’s
 算增量借貸利率並須作出若干實體特                    stand-alone credit rating).
 定的估計（如附屬公司的獨立信貸評
 級）。

                詳情如下：                                          which are described as follows:

                        計量日期可以取得的相同                                    active markets for identical assets or liabilities that
                        資產或負債於活躍市場之                                    the entity can access at the measurement date;
                        報價（未經調整）；


                (ii)    第二級輸入數據是就資產                            (ii)    Level 2 inputs are inputs, other than quoted prices
                        或負債直接或間接地可觀                                    included within Level 1, that are observable for the
                        察之輸入數據（第一級內包                                   asset or liability, either directly or indirectly;
                        括的報價除外）；


                (iii)   第三級輸入數據是資產或                            (iii)   Level 3 inputs are unobservable inputs for the asset
                        負債的不可觀察輸入數據。                                   or liability.
